--- delete_assert_rows_modified_return.sql
DELETE FROM Q WHERE id = 1 ASSERT_ROWS_MODIFIED 1 THEN RETURN id, Payload

  TableName: &ast.Path{
    Idents: []*ast.Ident{
      &ast.Ident{

        NameEnd: 13,

  },
  Where: &ast.Where{
    Where: 14,

      Op:   "=",
      Left: &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 20,
        NameEnd: 22,
        Name:    "id",

      Right: &ast.IntLiteral{
        ValuePos: 25,
        ValueEnd: 26,
        Base:     10,
        Value:    "1",

    },

  AssertRowsModified: &ast.AssertRowsModified{
    Assert:  27,

      ValuePos: 48,

      Base:     10,

    },

  ThenReturn: &ast.ThenReturn{
    Then:  50,
    Items: []ast.SelectItem{

        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
DELETE FROM Q WHERE id = 1 ASSERT_ROWS_MODIFIED 1 THEN RETURN id, Payload
